referenceEncoder.name: cbV2G
referenceEncoder.note: Wire-conformant ISO 15118-20 WPT reference. Each vector is a fixed message emitted by tools/cbv2g-ref/main_iso20.c (run: cbv2g_iso20 WPT_<name>). Header SessionID is 8x0x00, TimeStamp=1700000000, no Signature. The twelve cbV2G vectors are baseline coverage only: VendorSpecificDataContainer/ManufacturerSpecificDataContainer empty, WPT_LF_DataPackageList and LF_SystemSetupData absent -- those two fields exercise a grammar shape this repo's generator designed independently (no working cbV2G reference exists for it, see docs/xsd-inventory-15118-20.md). Until 2026-08-08 they were covered by self-consistency roundtrip tests alone, which cannot catch an encoder and decoder that are wrong in the same way; the four *_LFTransmitter*/*_LFReceiver* vectors below now cover LF_SystemSetupData with an independent codec instead. The C# test builds the matching message via Iso15118_20WptFixtures and diffs its bytes.

deviatesFromReferenceEncoder.verifiedBy: EXIficient 1.0.4 against ISO's own V2G_CI_WPT.xsd (decode -> re-encode -> identical octets)
deviatesFromReferenceEncoder.why: These four types are the only place in ISO 15118 with an optional repeating element followed by an optional one: VendorSpecificDataContainer (minOccurs=0 maxOccurs=16) then an optional WPT_LF_DataPackageList. cbexigen's grammar for that position contradicts its own input schema -- it unrolls only two list positions and hides the following particle from the zero-item state, so two perfectly valid documents cannot be encoded at all. With both absent its end-element is code 1 where the schema grammar has 2, which is the single bit that changed here (last byte 0x20->0x40, 0x02->0x04) and the reason a schema-following codec reported Premature EOS. Decided 2026-08-08 to follow the schema; ExiParticleGrammar=CbV2GCompatible restores cbexigen's bytes. cbV2G's bytes for these four are in git history at 31144ed.

vectors.name: WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq_LFTransmitter2
vectors.note: TxSpecData and PulseSequenceOrder, both minOccurs=2, at exactly the minimum — every occurrence forced, every start-element a 1-bit code.

vectors.name: WPT_FinePositioningSetupReq_LFTransmitter3
vectors.note: The same, one past the minimum: the third occurrence is the first real choice and widens to 2 bits. This is the transition that was encoded wrongly until 2026-08-07.
